# Test fixtures

Small, reviewable golden vectors live here. Each fixture identifies its upstream version, inputs, expected outputs, and generator provenance. No save files or personally identifying data are stored.

`skill_stream_v0.9.3.json` was generated by executing the upstream web calculator's `app.js` RNG and skill mapping functions at commit `c37b67d3d21d6b1c3318c8b6394e1c776dc876c3`. It covers the upstream sample, zero seed/counter, the upper documented base-seed bound with a nontrivial counter, and the pre-threshold counter-gate path.

`gogma_reset_stream_v0.9.3_live.json` contains six consecutive Reset Bonuses observations from the game, recorded with Artian Reroll Tracker 4.2.4 after exporting the pre-roll values with GARP v0.9.3. The game was then closed without saving.

Five rolls match GARP's Reset Bonuses simulation directly. The third exposes an upstream mismatch after bonus IDs 6 and 10 occupy the first and third slots. Runtime metadata identifies both as category 3 and gives that category a Gogma maximum of two. Removing the category at that point reproduces the remaining live slots.

`gogma_bonus_metadata_2026-08-23.json` is the reduced fixture derived from `GogmaConstraintProbe.json` with SHA-256 `32DFD643DD29FE63D88964EA1F9C811EFC02808D3144B6B260A6D1BC56BD27EC`. Runtime addresses and unrelated fields are omitted. It preserves the ten Gogma candidate IDs, order indices, categories, weights, rare flags, and maxima. The element data maximum is five, but its effective maximum is four because its only two exact IDs can each appear at most twice.

`gogma_bow_reset_stream_live_2026-08-23.json` contains six consecutive Reset
Bonuses previews from a Thunder Bow, recorded in seven Steam screenshots
(one pre-roll screen and six results). All 30 slots use only Attack, Affinity,
and Element bonuses. Removing Sharpness/Ammo IDs 6 and 10 from the weighted
pool reproduces the complete sequence at the previously known
`baseSeed=86315169` and `gogmaCounter=480`. The fixture stores each source
screenshot's SHA-256 without adding the image binaries to the repository.

`gogma_heavy_bowgun_reset_stream_live_2026-08-23.json` contains six
consecutive Reset Bonuses previews from an Ice Heavy Bowgun, recorded in seven
Steam screenshots. All 30 slots use only Attack, Affinity, and Ammo bonuses.
Removing Element IDs 11 and 14 from the weighted pool reproduces the complete
sequence at `baseSeed=86315169` and `gogmaCounter=480`. Heavy and Light Bowgun
share this candidate rule. The fixture stores screenshot SHA-256 values only.
